name: I'm a love interest in my childhood friend's Halloween story
source:
Celebrate Halloween with the main cast of 'I'm a love interest in my CHILDHOOD FRIEND'S reverse harem!!!' in this Spooktober game jam special.

[From [url=https://red-baby.itch.io/imaloveinterest-halloween2019]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与《我是我儿时朋友的反向后宫的恋爱对象！！！》的主要演员一起庆祝万圣节！在这个Spooktober游戏即兴特辑中。

[来自[url=https://red-baby.itch.io/imaloveinterest-halloween2019]itch.io[/url]]
